title: Task Management Guide
content: Complete guide to managing tasks in TYT Platform v2 using JSON-driven Kanban workflow with CLI and UI integration.

items.title: Task Management Overview
items.why: Organize and track platform development work
items.what: JSON-based Kanban system (TODO → IN_PROGRESS → DONE → REOPEN)
items.how: Use CLI commands or web UI to create, view, and manage tasks

items.title: Create New Task
items.what: Generate task JSON with schema validation
items.how: make task-new id=003-feature-name title='Feature description' priority=High assignee='Name'

items.title: List Tasks
items.why: View current work status across all categories
items.what: Filter tasks by status (TODO, IN_PROGRESS, DONE, REOPEN)
items.how: make task-list [status=TODO] - omit status to see all tasks

items.title: View Task Details
items.why: See full task information including subtasks and criteria
items.what: Display task metadata, acceptance criteria, subtasks, tags, files
items.how: make task-show id=001-task-name - or click task card in web UI

items.title: Move Task Between Statuses
items.what: Change task status with automatic history logging

items.title: Complete Task
items.how: make task-done id=001-task-name - automatically logs completion

items.title: Reopen Task
items.what: Move DONE task to REOPEN status

items.title: Task Schema Structure
items.why: Understand task data model for editing
items.what: Required: id, title, status, created; Optional: priority, assignee, description, acceptanceCriteria, subtasks, tags, relatedFiles, notes
items.how: See tasks/schema.json for full specification; edit task JSON files directly in tasks/data/{status}/

items.title: Web UI Task Management
items.what: View tasks in doc-site with filtering, sorting, detail view
items.how: Navigate to Tasks section in sidebar → filter by status → click card for details

items.title: Task Validation
items.why: Ensure JSON integrity and schema compliance
items.what: Validate all task files against schema
items.how: make task-validate - checks all tasks in all statuses

items.title: Acceptance Criteria & Subtasks
items.why: Break down tasks into measurable outcomes
items.what: Define completion criteria and trackable sub-items
items.how: Edit task JSON: add to acceptanceCriteria[] or subtasks[] arrays with {id, text, completed}

items.title: Task Best Practices
items.why: Maintain clean and useful task system
items.what: Use descriptive IDs (001-feature-name), add acceptance criteria, link related files, tag appropriately
items.how: Follow pattern: clear title → detailed description → acceptance criteria → subtasks → tags → related files
